req.title: Register rejects duplicate username
req.statement: The system shall render an error message when POST /auth/register is called with a username already present in the users table.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject duplicate usernames during registration. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_register_new_user
preconditions: The database is initialized with the default users.
actions: Attempt to register a new user with a unique username.
expected: The registration should succeed, redirecting to the login page.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'NewUser', 'password': 'newpass'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

tests.name: test_register_duplicate_username
preconditions: The database is initialized with the default users.
actions: Attempt to register a user with a username that already exists.
expected: The registration should fail with an error message indicating the username is already registered.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'newpass'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'User Rahul is already registered.' in r.data

tests.name: test_register_boundary_username
preconditions: The database is initialized with the default users.
actions: Attempt to register a user with a username that is at the boundary of being unique.
expected: The registration should succeed if the username is unique, otherwise fail with an error message.
trace: Success or Error: User <name> is already registered.
tests.executable:
